title: Thunderbird having trouble with formatted text pasted from Google Docs when composing
creator: trlist1
content:
I am having some trouble with copy and paste when composing. The background here is that I never was a good typist, and I have some physical difficulties (essential tremor) that make typing more difficult now. My solution for this is to use Google Docs’ Voice Typing feature to dictate most of what I write. I often do formatting there as well.

If I then paste unformatted from Google Docs into the TB compose window things generally work pretty well. However, if I paste formatted text there are a number of problems. Some of this is because Google Docs is inserting far too much unnecessary junk into the HTML for the formatted text (I looked with HTML Source Editor). But some of it seems to be problems in TB, here are examples of some of the things I've seen:

  • Pasted text ends up being seen by Thunderbird as a mix of Paragraph and Body Text. When I highlight it and try to switch it all to Body Text basically the change is ignored, that is, sections of the text still remain in Paragraph format. This messes up line spacing.
  • Font changes in pasted text have similar oddities. Google's fonts and font sizes often don't match up with the ones I have set in Thunderbird, and if I try to highlight the pasted text and adjust the font size using Thunderbird's font controls, frequently nothing changes.
  • Vertical navigation in pasted text is sometimes broken. The main symptom is that using the down arrow to move the cursor down through the pasted paragraphs works until you get to the last paragraph, but then instead of going down into the signature it jumps back to the beginning of the message, so it is cyclical rather than simply continuing down. If I use the down arrow to go to the last line and then a right arrow to go character by character the cursor moves into the signature area as expected, it's only the vertical arrows that are weird.

Are these bugs that are worth documenting and reporting? Is the above enough info to reproduce them? Or is it too much to ask Thunderbird to handle pasted formatted text better than it does?

I am also happy to hear other suggestions for speech to text tools that would do a better job of solving the underlying problem. Google Voice Typing leaves a lot to be desired.

Thanks!

title: Server Settings::"When I delete": folder forgotten on quit
creator: brec
content:
Upon opening the macOS application, Server Settings "When I delete a message:" on my primary email account appears as shown in the image. If I don't change the dropdown to select Trash, deleted messages disappear as if the "Remove it immediately" radio button were on.

I have my Mac set to open Thunderbird at startup; after (infrequent) rebooting I haven't remembered to change the dropdown menu setting until I go looking in vain in Trash for a recently-deleted message that I want to review.

Docs say that Trash is the default, and another IMAP email account retains the "Trash" folder setting across Thunderbird restarts, so I believe that it being forgotten for my primary account is a bug or corruption symptom.

This issue has been present for some unknown number of versions through the current one.
